scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-01 defender BDI beliefs are derived from process model parts

steps.text: a control structure where RESP-1 has process model parts PM-1-1 and PM-1-2
the defender BDI is pre-populated for RESP-1
the defender BDI has 2 beliefs
belief 1 references pm_id PM-1-1
belief 2 references pm_id PM-1-2
each belief content matches the process model part description

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-02 defender BDI desires are derived from the responsibility

steps.text: a control structure where RESP-1 has description "Authorize payment operations"
the defender BDI is pre-populated for RESP-1
the defender BDI has at least 1 desire
each desire references resp_id RESP-1
each desire content matches the responsibility description

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-03 defender BDI intentions are derived from control actions

steps.text: a control structure where RESP-1 has control actions CA-1-1 and CA-1-2
the defender BDI is pre-populated for RESP-1
the defender BDI has 2 intentions
intention 1 references ca_id CA-1-1
intention 2 references ca_id CA-1-2
each intention content matches the control action description

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-04 defender belief vulnerability fields are empty before the LLM call

steps.text: the defender BDI is pre-populated for RESP-1
every belief has an empty vulnerability field

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-05 one LLM call per scenario fills vulnerability annotations and attacker BDI

steps.text: an LLM that returns defender vulnerabilities for each PM and a valid attacker BDI
the BDI generation LLM call is executed for the scenario
exactly 1 LLM call is made
the call is labeled with stage stage_5
the call step is bdi_generation

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-06 LLM fills non-empty vulnerability annotations on each defender belief

steps.text: an LLM that returns vulnerability annotations for PM-1-1 and PM-1-2
the BDI generation LLM call is executed and vulnerabilities are merged
every defender belief has a non-empty vulnerability annotation

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-07 LLM generates attacker BDI with beliefs, desires, and intentions

steps.text: an LLM that returns an attacker BDI with 3 beliefs, 2 desires, and 3 intentions
the BDI generation LLM call is executed
the attacker BDI has 3 beliefs
the attacker BDI has 2 desires
the attacker BDI has 3 intentions

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-08 attacker BDI beliefs reference defender process model weaknesses

steps.text: an LLM that returns an attacker BDI whose beliefs reference PM-1-1
the BDI generation LLM call is executed
at least one attacker belief references PM-1-1

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-09 ScenarioSpec is assembled with threat source and catalog context

steps.text: a structural threat with ica_slot_id RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED and provenance structural
the threat has catalog mappings for OWASP_AGENTIC T1
the ScenarioSpec is assembled
the scenario spec has threat_source ica_slot_id RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED
the scenario spec has threat_source provenance structural
the scenario spec has target_controller RESP-1
the scenario spec has target_control_action CA-1-1
the scenario spec has ica_type NOT_PROVIDED
the scenario spec has catalog context with 1 mapping

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-10 scenario ID follows SCN-NNN format

steps.text: the ScenarioSpec is assembled for the first scenario
the scenario_id matches the pattern SCN-NNN

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-11 post-call validation checks BDI grounding against control structure

steps.text: a defender BDI with all beliefs, desires, and intentions referencing valid control structure IDs
the scenario spec is validated against the control structure
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-12 post-call validation fails on non-existent PM reference

steps.text: a defender BDI with a belief referencing PM-99-1
the scenario spec is validated against the control structure
validation fails with error containing pm_id

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-13 post-call validation fails on non-existent CA reference

steps.text: a defender BDI with an intention referencing CA-99-1
the scenario spec is validated against the control structure
validation fails with error containing ca_id

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-14 post-call validation fails on target_control_action not belonging to target_controller

steps.text: a control structure with RESP-1 and RESP-2 where CA-2-1 belongs to RESP-2
a scenario spec with target_controller RESP-1 and target_control_action CA-2-1
the scenario spec is validated against the control structure
validation fails with error containing target_control_action

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-15 vulnerability completeness check fails on empty vulnerability

steps.text: a defender BDI where belief PM-1-1 has an empty vulnerability annotation
vulnerability completeness validation is performed
validation fails with error containing vulnerability

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-16 LLM-altered defender BDI IDs are replaced with deterministic values

steps.text: an LLM that returns defender vulnerabilities with altered pm_id values
the BDI generation result is processed
the defender BDI uses the original deterministic pm_id values
the vulnerability annotations are extracted by matching to the original pm_id values

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-17 user prompt includes pre-populated defender BDI, ICA, and control structure context

steps.text: an LLM that records the user prompt
the BDI generation LLM call is executed
the user prompt contains the pre-populated defender BDI with empty vulnerability fields
the user prompt contains the ICA text
the user prompt contains the hazardous context
the user prompt contains the loss scenario
the user prompt contains the control structure context for RESP-1

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-18 system prompt defines the dual-BDI interaction model

steps.text: the BDI generation LLM call is executed
the system prompt contains instructions for defender vulnerability annotation
the system prompt contains instructions for attacker BDI generation
the system prompt requires attacker intentions to reference PM or FB or CA elements

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-19 strict 1:1 ICA-to-scenario cardinality

steps.text: an enriched threat set with 5 structural threats
BDI generation is performed for all threats
exactly 5 ScenarioSpec instances are produced
each scenario corresponds to exactly one structural threat

scenarios.name: SP3-BDI-20 all LLM calls are logged to calls.jsonl

steps.text: a run directory for output
an LLM that returns valid BDI generation results
BDI generation is performed for all threats
a file calls.jsonl exists in the run directory
the file contains entries with stage stage_5

a control structure with responsibility RESP-1 having process model parts PM-1-1 and PM-1-2, control actions CA-1-1 and CA-1-2, and feedback channels FB-1-1
